title: FLOOD HAZARD AREAS
officialText:
706.1 General. Within areas of special flood hazard in accordance with Section 28-104.9.4 of the
Administrative Code, all work for any activity regulated by Appendix G of the New York City
Building Code shall be governed by such Appendix.
